zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73N 的全部 130 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。
en: This page retains the complete sequence from R0.61 through R0.73N, comprising 130 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W proceeds from the reduced recurrence to strict annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B addresses strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the full linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I sequentially treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer into a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance departure, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies the inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes the parameter-uniform viscous rank-one spectral branch, R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then uses the full action to prescribe the seed and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance departure at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), and trajectories remain in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional perturbations, singularity, and Clay are not extrapolated. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) while the background varies accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: any pair of coexisting strong solutions satisfies a finite accumulated-strain bound; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Consequently, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a single fixed background.

Transverse three-dimensional critical growth, singularity, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 下一关是 R0.73O：为强迫、非衰减或无限累积应变等结构不同的固定背景重新冻结候选问题，先寻找 能够逃离本节有限总应变稳定管的必要结构，而不能把 R0.73M 的现有背景族直接 重新标记。
en: R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) while the background varies accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: any pair of coexisting strong solutions satisfies a finite accumulated-strain bound; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Consequently, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a single fixed background. The next gate is R0.73O: refreeze a candidate problem for a structurally different fixed background, such as one with forcing, no decay, or infinite accumulated strain, and first identify a necessary structure capable of escaping this section's finite-total-strain stability tube; the existing R0.73M background family cannot simply be relabeled.

zh: R0.73N 对 R0.73M 的“变背景族能否转化为单个固定背景不稳定性”作出否定 判定。对显式无外力双谐波背景族中的每个固定有限 \(\Lambda\)，直接能量、 交换子与延拓估计给出一个正的全三维同步 \((H^3,H^3)\) 稳定管；R0.73M 所捕捉的是跨无界标记背景族的非一致指向放大，而不是任一固定成员处的 Lyapunov 不稳定性。
en: R0.73N gives a negative answer to R0.73M's question of whether a varying-background family can be converted into instability on a single fixed background. For every fixed finite \(\Lambda\) in the explicit unforced two-harmonic background family, direct energy, commutator, and continuation estimates yield a positive full-three-dimensional synchronized \((H^3,H^3)\) stability tube; R0.73M captures nonuniform marked-basepoint amplification across an unbounded labeled family of backgrounds, not Lyapunov instability at any fixed member.
